summary.intent: Execute Phase 35 (Phala Testnet TEE Migration) end-to-end using GSD wave-based execution, migrating the TEE worker into the apps/ monorepo structure and deploying it to Phala Cloud CVM testnet.
summary.outcome: All 6 plans completed across 4 waves: TEE worker restructured into apps/tee-worker/ with shared package integration, 56 unit tests passing, Phala SDK integrated with Prometheus metrics, staging CI/CD updated, docs updated, and CVM successfully deployed to Phala Cloud testnet with epoch key determinism and IPNS republish verified.

repo: TEE worker lives at apps/tee-worker/ (moved from root tee-worker/ in this phase)
Shared packages used by TEE worker: @cipherbox/crypto (ECIES/HKDF), @cipherbox/core (IPNS signing), @cipherbox/sdk-core (KuboProvider, PsaProvider)
Docker host is at 192.168.133.12 (not 192.168.133.114 as previously recorded)
TEE worker secret env var in GitHub is STAGING_TEE_WORKER_SECRET
PHALA_TEE_WORKER_URL is set as a GitHub staging environment variable (not secret)
Epoch key determinism confirmed: same 64-byte uncompressed public key across CVM restarts
Republish latency ~1155ms avg from remote to Phala Cloud testnet — network-bound, not compute-bound

code.finding: Republish route expects ECIES-encrypted IPNS key payload using wrapKey/unwrapKey from @cipherbox/crypto
Key manager uses @cipherbox/crypto for ECIES operations and HKDF-based key derivation
Phala CVM deployment config; uses envsubst for variable injection before phala deploy
Has build-tee and deploy-tee-phala jobs added in this phase for Phala Cloud deployment

workflow: GSD worktree isolation: executor agents run in git worktrees; merging requires manual conflict resolution for STATE.md/ROADMAP.md (take agent version)
Sequential wave execution needed when parallel agents cause git config lock contention — clean up stale worktrees before retrying
GSD pause-work/resume-work handoff cycle works well for cross-machine session transfer; HANDOFF.json preserves credentials and exact task state
phala CLI (v1.1.13): `phala deploy -c docker-compose.yml -n <name> -e KEY=VAL --wait` for initial deploy; `phala restart -n <name>` to restart
Phala CVM health endpoint: GET /health returns {healthy, mode, epoch}; public key at GET /public-key
@cipherbox/crypto package must be built (pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build) before use in test scripts
classifyHandoffIfNeeded error in Claude Code is a runtime bug, not a GSD failure — spot-check SUMMARY.md + git commits to confirm success

friction: Wave 2 parallel agents failed: 35-02 hit git config lock, 35-03 hit usage quota mid-execution — required sequential retry after cleanup
gsd-tools init runs from wrong directory when in worktree context — needed explicit path adjustment
Stale HANDOFF.json listed Dockerfile as uncommitted when it had already been committed by Docker host session
CVM restart took several minutes with empty reply SSL errors before becoming healthy — required polling with increasing delays
TEE_WORKER_SECRET not available locally (only in GitHub secrets) — required generating a new one
Docker not available on dev machine (192.168.133.12 is separate Docker host) — required cross-machine handoff for image build
Two session handoffs required: once to Docker host for image build, then back for verification tasks
